page.heading: Built to remove the resume
page.body: ResumeDOG was created for recruitment teams that spend too much time turning raw candidate files into polished, client-ready submissions. The product is designed to reduce repetitive formatting, translation, anonymization, and editing work before resumes reach clients.

why.label: Why ResumeDOG Exists
why.heading: Strong candidates should not be slowed down by
why.p1: Recruiters are judged on speed, accuracy, and the quality of candidate submissions. But before a candidate can be sent to a client, recruiters often need to clean formatting, rewrite unclear sections, translate content, anonymize personal details, and adjust the document to fit agency or client expectations.
why.p2: ResumeDOG exists to make that preparation process faster and more consistent, while still leaving final judgment and review in the hands of recruiters.

faqs.q: What can recruiters do with ResumeDOG?
faqs.a: Recruiters can format resumes, translate between English and Japanese, anonymize selected candidate details, adjust resume sections, and export client-ready documents in Word or PDF.
Yes. ResumeDOG is currently focused on English-Japanese resume translation, with additional language support planned.
Yes. ResumeDOG includes anonymization functions that allow recruiters to hide selected candidate details before client submission.

faqs.q: Can I control which candidate details are hidden?
faqs.a: Depending on the plan and settings, recruiters can control details such as name, phone number, email address, and other personal information before export.

faqs.q: Does ResumeDOG support job description matching?
faqs.a: Job description matching is available in selected plans. Recruiters can add job description details to help tailor resumes to a specific role.

faqs.q: Can I export resumes in Word and PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. ResumeDOG supports Word and PDF export depending on the selected output settings and plan.
